findings.evidence: Still resolved: durable FIFO remains before the expanded execution value milestone.
findings.root_cause: The original task graph omitted a value prerequisite.

findings.evidence: Still resolved by the composite projection source identity and same-transaction source-change/outbox contract.
findings.root_cause: Canonical revision alone omitted independent event/checkpoint changes.

findings.evidence: Still resolved by stable 500-event logical groups backed by bounded content-addressed physical blocks.
findings.root_cause: The original representation conflated logical count and physical byte bounds.

findings.evidence: Still resolved by the single pre-writable FRESH/HUMAN_RESUME/LEGACY/INVALID/FUTURE dispatcher.
findings.root_cause: Startup mode was not atomically selected before writable openers.

findings.evidence: Still resolved by the frozen facade authority matrix and Host-derived subject/object lineage.
findings.root_cause: The original facade did not separate payload selectors from Host authority.

findings.evidence: Still resolved by the durable turn/Run reducers, control precedence, generation fencing and one-to-one SDK binding; A2 only adds the execution composition below them.
findings.root_cause: The original plan lacked an executable durable reducer.

findings.evidence: Still resolved by the durable fence, transaction writer check, worker ack/watermark and FULL checkpoint contract; the new finding only requires adding v44 writers.
findings.root_cause: The original recovery path lacked a transaction-level quiescence boundary.

findings.evidence: Still resolved by TC-HM-14 and the structured required scenario mapping; A2 requires extending, not replacing, that oracle.
findings.root_cause: The original testcase set omitted the Host recovery/integration lane.

findings.evidence: Still resolved by the A/B/C/D taxonomy and typed per-row leaf comparison; A2 requires classifying v44 tables within it.
findings.root_cause: The original manifest lacked a delta-aware table taxonomy.

findings.evidence: The draft adds an initial ContextRouteReceipt to RunStart/StartSnapshot but does not distinguish Host-initial provenance from context-tool raw-call/effect provenance, assign an ordinary start wire version, or define existing-checkpoint conflicts.
findings.root_cause: A2 added a new SDK start authority without freezing its wire, provenance and checkpoint recovery contract.
findings.why_not_found_in_round_one: The initial routed SDK start contract was out of scope before A2.

findings.evidence: The draft prepares Context/Provider/Tool authority before claim_next creates host_run_id, owner, generation and lease, allowing a losing scheduler to retain executable authority.
findings.root_cause: The plan does not separate an inert pre-claim draft from generation-bound post-claim authority.
findings.why_not_found_in_round_one: Real Provider/Tool preparation and SDK admission entered scope only through A2.

findings.evidence: The draft says to reuse provider/context/tool seams, but the current provider and context helpers require SessionDB and legacy session history; no replacement typed source ports are frozen.
findings.root_cause: The desired canonical primary/TaskScope source boundary is stated negatively but not expressed as constructor-bound ports.
findings.why_not_found_in_round_one: Foreground Context/Provider/Tool composition was previously deferred to S5.

findings.evidence: v44 adds immutable execution audit rows, but the recovery writer registry, A/B/C/D taxonomy, fence triggers and export allowlist do not enumerate them.
findings.root_cause: The A2 schema was appended after the v39-v43 recovery taxonomy had converged.
findings.why_not_found_in_round_one: v44 did not exist in the earlier scope.

findings.evidence: The draft requests an exact candidate wheel but does not freeze Host pin files, installed module origin, public contract identity, or old/new compatibility oracles.
findings.root_cause: A cross-repository candidate dependency needs a post-build identity contract, not only a source change.
findings.why_not_found_in_round_one: The prior plan consumed released SDK 0.7.0 and had no candidate protocol.
